verdict.rationale: Firstbase offers a registered agent service in all 50 states and a mail plan with unlimited incoming mail and scans. However, nothing in the evidence describes how service of process is handled, or how legal papers are separated from ordinary mail with distinct delivery commitments. Mail-scanning features are an adjacent capability, not this one.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider documents how service of legal papers is handled separately from ordinary mail, with distinct delivery commitments
